values.note: recreation.gov lists 11 back-in gravel sites with driveways of 22-38 ft, and one of 57 ft (site 6); the FS also describes one pull-through. Two vehicles at most per site, one RV or trailer.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog 10244097 + facility notice + FS page, read 2026-11-20

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault Toilet (2)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Five of the 11 sites are reservable July 1 to early September; the other six, and every site after Labor Day, are first-come.

booking.source: recreation.gov catalog (6 sites 'Not Reservable') + rates (Peak July 1 - Sept 7, Walk-In after) + notice ('Maximum length of stay is 14 days'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Fees are charged July 1 to October 31 (2026); the rest of the year the campground may be used free, with no services, as weather and the road allow.

note: High Medicine Bow NF campground near Sand Lake in the Snowy Range, reached on gravel Forest Roads 100 and 101 from WY-130 or on Carbon County Road 101 from Elk Mountain. Pack out all trash. --Claude
